results.title: Twilight Sparkle
results.description: You’re the wise, curious leader who loves learning and growth! Like Twilight, you’re thoughtful, organized, and value knowledge and friendship deeply. You care about harmony and work hard to help those around you. You’re an INFJ—insightful, determined, and driven by meaning.

results.title: Pinkie Pie
results.description: You’re the joyful, energetic spirit who brings fun to every day! Like Pinkie Pie, you’re outgoing, playful, and live to make others laugh. You love surprises, parties, and living in the moment. You’re an ESFP—energetic, warm, and full of life.

results.title: Rainbow Dash
results.description: You’re the bold, loyal adventurer who loves speed and courage! Like Rainbow Dash, you’re confident, competitive, and always ready for action. You value loyalty and aren’t afraid to be yourself. You’re an ESTP—brave, spontaneous, and true to your friends.

results.title: Rarity
results.description: You’re the creative, generous soul who loves beauty and kindness! Like Rarity, you’re elegant, imaginative, and enjoy making things special for others. You have a big heart and a love for style and detail. You’re an ENFJ—charming, caring, and naturally inspiring.

results.title: Fluttershy
results.description: You’re the gentle, kind heart who loves quiet and care! Like Fluttershy, you’re soft-spoken, compassionate, and deeply connected to living things. You’re brave when it matters most and value peace. You’re an ISFP—gentle, creative, and full of quiet strength.

results.title: Applejack
results.description: You’re the honest, hardworking friend everyone can trust! Like Applejack, you’re reliable, down-to-earth, and value honesty and loyalty. You work hard, help your family, and stay true to yourself. You’re an ISTJ—practical, steady, and deeply loyal.

results.title: Starlight Glimmer
results.description: You’re the thoughtful, growing soul who learns and improves! Like Starlight, you’re reflective, logical, and care about friendship and understanding. You grow stronger every day and value connection. You’re an INTP—curious, thoughtful, and always evolving.

results.title: Spike
results.description: You’re the loyal, helpful friend who supports those you love! Like Spike, you’re caring, reliable, and always there for your friends. You love small joys and big loyalty. You’re an ISFJ—kind, dependable, and full of heart.

results.title: Princess Celestia
results.description: You’re the wise, kind leader who guides with warmth! Like Celestia, you’re calm, wise, and care about helping others grow. You lead gently and inspire hope. You’re an ENFJ—compassionate, visionary, and full of grace.

results.title: Princess Luna
results.description: You’re the deep, mysterious soul with a big heart! Like Luna, you’re thoughtful, creative, and connected to dreams and emotion. You care deeply and protect those you love. You’re an INFP—imaginative, deep, and full of quiet magic.

results.title: Shining Armor
results.description: You’re the brave, protective friend who stands for family! Like Shining Armor, you’re loyal, responsible, and willing to defend those you love. You’re steady and kind. You’re an ESTJ—responsible, protective, and reliable.

results.title: Cadance
results.description: You’re the loving, joyful soul who spreads love! Like Cadance, you’re warm, kind, and believe in the power of love and friendship. You make every moment brighter. You’re an ESFJ—loving, social, and full of warmth.

results.title: Discord
results.description: You’re the playful, creative spirit who loves chaos and fun! Like Discord, you’re imaginative, witty, and enjoy being unique. You have a big heart hidden beneath fun. You’re an ENTP—clever, creative, and full of surprises.

results.title: Trixie
results.description: You’re the confident, fun performer with a big heart! Like Trixie, you’re outgoing, dramatic, and love to shine. You learn and grow and care about friendship. You’re an ENFP—expressive, creative, and full of spirit.

results.title: Zecora
results.description: You’re the wise, mysterious friend with gentle wisdom! Like Zecora, you’re calm, thoughtful, and offer kind guidance. You’re unique and wise in your own way. You’re an INTJ—insightful, independent, and quietly wise.

results.title: Big Macintosh
results.description: You’re the quiet, strong soul who speaks through actions! Like Big Mac, you’re calm, reliable, and kind without needing many words. You’re steady and deeply loyal. You’re an ISTP—calm, practical, and quietly strong.
